title: Flow Delete Must Not Reorganize
description: When deleting nodes in flow, nodes are wrongly reorganized. Reorganizing should only happen when manually called via the reorganize engagement.
summary: Fixed flow node deletion triggering automatic tree layout. `DagHost::delete_selected` was calling `rebuild_engine()` which applied `apply_dag_layout_to_fixture_v1_value` with default options, reorganizing all remaining nodes. Changed it to `rebuild_engine_with_layout(false)` so positions are preserved; layout now only runs via explicit `reorganize()`. Added regression test `dag_host_delete_selected_preserves_remaining_positions`. Removed unused `rebuild_engine` helper.
